title: Catalog Page
description: Property catalog/listing page with grid layout. Filter by type (jual/sewa), price range, and location. URL-based filter state for shareable links.

inScope: Filter by property type: Jual or Sewa
URL-based filter state for shareable links

acceptanceCriteria.text: Property cards display in responsive grid layout
Filter by type (Jual/Sewa) updates grid results
Filter by price range (min/max) updates grid results
Filter by location updates grid results
Filter state is reflected in URL for shareable links
Clicking a property card navigates to property detail page
Page uses ISR with on-demand revalidation when admin updates properties
